jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Introduction

University of the People (UoPeople) is the first non-profit, tuition-free, American, accredited, 100% online university. Today, UoPeople has over 170,000 students enrolled from more than 200 countries and territories, including 18,800 students who are refugees. UoPeople is accredited by the WASC Senior College and University Commission (WSCUC).
We believe that higher education is a basic human right and that it can transform not only the lives of students, but also their families’ lives, their communities, their nations, and, by extension, the world. See President Reshef’s TED Talk when he announced the founding of the University.
UoPeople is an innovative university, and we welcome team members who bring creativity and innovation to their roles. We’re a fast-paced organization with remote teams all around the globe. If you’re a self-starter who wants to succeed alongside a passionate team, we’d love to hear from you!
UoPeople is supported by the generosity of individuals and foundations, including the Gates, Hewlett, Ford Foundations, Foundation Hoffmann, and others. The University has been covered by The New York Times, BBC, NPR, Times Higher Education, U.S. News & World Report, and many other leading media outlets. President Reshef’s TED Talk and Nas Daily interview about the University have more than 30 million combined views

General purpose

The Project Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of assigned strategic initiatives within the University’s Program Management Office (PMO).
Reporting to the Senior Program Manager, PMO Lead, the Project Manager will support a portfolio of strategic initiatives spanning Product, Technology, Operations, and other cross-functional workstreams. The role will work closely with Product, Technology, business leaders, and other stakeholders to establish clear plans, coordinate dependencies, manage risks, and ensure projects are delivered against agreed scope, timelines, and PMO governance standards.
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive project management professional who is comfortable managing multiple concurrent initiatives in a fast-paced, global, remote environment. The successful candidate will bring strong ownership, structured execution, clear communication, and the ability to drive accountability across teams without direct authority.

Essential functions & responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution
– Own the end-to-end delivery of assigned projects within the PMO portfolio, from planning and initiation through execution, monitoring, and closure. Ensure projects remain aligned with agreed objectives, scope, timelines, and expected outcomes.

Project Planning & Tracking
– Build and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, workstreams, and dependency maps. Ensure project information remains accurate and current throughout the project lifecycle.

Project Health & Reporting
– Monitor project health and provide regular RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status reporting for assigned initiatives. Identify emerging risks, issues, blockers, and scope changes and ensure appropriate actions are taken.

Cross-Functional Coordination
– Coordinate closely with Product, Technology, Operations, and other workstream leads to ensure deliverables are clearly defined, appropriately sequenced, and delivered on time.

Stakeholder Management –
Establish effective working relationships with stakeholders across the University, including senior leaders, business drivers, Product and Technology teams, and other functional partners. Drive alignment and accountability across teams and stakeholders outside the direct reporting line.

Project Governance & Meetings
– Facilitate structured project touchpoints, including project check-ins, initial alignment meetings with Business Drivers and executives, and other governance meetings. Ensure decisions, risks, action items, and ownership are clearly documented and followed through.

Project Intake & Scoping
– Support the intake and initial scoping of new project requests. Ensure requests are appropriately documented, logged, assessed, and routed through established PMO governance processes.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management –
Proactively identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints. Escalate material risks, resourcing gaps, unresolved dependencies, or scope concerns in a timely and well-documented manner.

Project Documentation & PMO Standards
– Maintain high-quality project documentation, including project records, project plans, status logs, meeting notes,
decision logs, action trackers, and project summaries. Ensure documentation consistently meets PMO standards.

Project Management Tools & Systems
– Maintain accurate project information within the team’s project planning and tracking tools, including workflows, boards, milestones, status fields, and other PMO tracking mechanisms.

PMO Continuous Improvement
– Contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO tools, templates, governance practices, reporting standards, and project management processes.
Key competencies

· Project Delivery & Execution
– Strong ability to plan, organize, and drive projects from initiation through completion while maintaining focus on scope, timelines, dependencies, and outcomes.

· Organization & Attention to Detail
– Highly structured and detail-oriented, with strong discipline in maintaining accurate project plans, documentation, tracking, and reporting.

· Stakeholder Management & Collaboration
– Builds effective relationships across functions and works confidently with stakeholders outside the direct reporting line to achieve shared objectives.

· Communication & Executive Reporting
– Communicates clearly and proactively, with the ability to translate complex project information into concise, structured updates appropriate for different audiences.
· Risk & Problem Management
– Identifies risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies early and takes appropriate action to resolve or escalate them.

· Accountability & Ownership
– Takes full ownership of assigned projects and confidently holds stakeholders accountable for agreed timelines, deliverables, and actions.

· Adaptability & Prioritization
– Effectively manages competing priorities and changing requirements while maintaining visibility of overall project health and critical deliverables.

· Continuous Improvement Mindset
– Identifies opportunities to improve project management processes, tools, templates, and ways of working across the PMO.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in business, project management, technology, operations, or a related field required.
· 4+ years of progressive experience in project management, ideally within a PMO, technology, Product, or cross-functional operations environment.
· Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities, dependencies, and deadlines.
· MBA, PMP, or equivalent project management certification preferred.
· Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured project updates and reports for different audiences.
· Demonstrated ability to work independently and effectively in a global, remote, and distributed team environment.
· Experience coordinating and influencing stakeholders outside the direct reporting line, including Product, Technology, and business teams.
· Hands-on experience with Jira or equivalent project and work-tracking tools preferred; training can be provided.
· Experience working within higher education, EdTech, or a similarly regulated or academic environment preferred.
· Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies alongside traditional project management and governance practices preferred.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

· Projects are delivered on time, within agreed scope, and aligned with initiative objectives.
· Project plans, milestones, dependencies, and status information are accurate and consistently up to date.
· Risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies are identified early and proactively managed.
· Stakeholders receive timely, clear, and effective communication on project progress and risks.
· Project decisions and action items are documented, assigned clear ownership, and tracked through completion.
· Multiple concurrent projects are managed effectively without compromising quality or PMO standards.
· Project governance, documentation, and reporting consistently meet established PMO expectations.
· The Project Manager independently drives execution, creates accountability, and ensures cross-functional teams remain aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Job description for Project Manager - Change

The Joint Asset Management and Engineering Solutions (JAMES) is a mission-critical Defence information system supporting over 40,000 users and millions of equipment records across Defence. As a key enabler of Asset and Engineering Management, JAMES plays a vital role in supporting Whole Fleet Management across the Defence enterprise.

We are looking for a JAMES Project Manager - Change to plan, coordinate and deliver change activities that enable the successful adoption of new business, security, safety and regulatory changes within JAMES. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the evolution of a critical Defence capability, ensuring change is effectively governed, aligned to organisational objectives and delivers measurable benefits.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing complex information systems change, ensuring technology-enabled initiatives are successfully delivered whilst balancing stakeholder needs, risks and dependencies. You will work closely with a wide range of stakeholders to understand requirements, coordinate change activity and specialise in project management supporting the implementation of change requests. Success in the role will depend on your ability to consider the impact of change across people, processes and technology, using data-driven insights to inform decision-making and ensure sustainable adoption.

Working in partnership with the Lead Engineer, you will ensure the JAMES Adaptive Change Programme remains current and continues to meet safety and legislative policy. You will play an important role in maintaining and enhancing the system's ability to support Asset and Engineering Management activities across Defence, ensuring it continues to meet the needs of Whole Fleet Management.

Please note that due to the nature of the role, regular attendance on site at Battlesbury Barracks, Warminster, Wiltshire, BA12 9DT will be required. You should expect to attend this duty station at a minimum of one to two days per week, with additional attendance expected based on project requirements.

What you’ll be doing

Define and implement the JAMES change strategy aligned to business, security, safety and regulatory objectives, ensuring integration with wider delivery plans and benefits across the Logistics and Support portfolio.
Establish and maintain change governance and control processes, ensuring all JAMES changes are managed, approved and compliant with policy and standards.
Conduct detailed change impact assessments on JAMES systems, processes, data and users, identifying implications across cost, schedule, performance and service delivery.
Develop and execute stakeholder engagement plans, managing relationships across business, technical teams, suppliers and end users.
Design and deliver communication strategies that clearly articulate system changes, impacts and required behaviours to ensure adoption.
Manage risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and opportunities (RAIDO) associated with JAMES change, ensuring timely mitigation and escalation.

Person specification

To be successful with your application, you'll need to show that you meet the following essential criteria
:

Evidence of understanding of how systems, data and technology changes impact business operations and delivery.
Ability to influence, negotiate and maintain effective relationships across diverse audiences.
Strong understanding of governance frameworks, compliance and structured change processes.
Evidence of identifying, assessing and managing risks and dependencies in complex environments.
Experience of managing the relationships between programmes, schedules and technical components.
Evidence of interpreting management information, assessing change effectiveness, challenging assumptions and embedding lessons learned into future delivery.

In addition to the responsibilities above, the following technical competences and behaviours
will be assessed at interview:

Core Behaviour 1
: Making Effective Decisions – CSBC3
Core Behaviour 2
: Changing and Improving – CSBC3
Technical Competence 1
: Stakeholder Management – Supervised Practitioner
Technical Competence 2
: Controlling a Project – Practitioner

Benefits

Alongside your salary of £44,100, Ministry of Defence contributes £12,775 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

25 days’ annual leave +1 day a year up to 30 days, 8 bank holidays and a day off for the King’s birthday

Market-leading average employer pension contribution of 28.97%
Annual performance-based bonus and recognition awards
Access to specialist training and funded qualifications
Support for progression
Huge range of discounts
Volunteering days

jobs.description:
Job Description

Location:
Bellevue, WA, Boston, MA, or Plantation, FL

Hybrid:
3 days/week in office

Our Opportunity

Chewy’s mission is to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents and partners everywhere. We view pets and pet parents as family and are obsessed with meeting their needs and exceeding expectations through every interaction. Within Chewy, the Payments team improves the customer and care team experience by launching better ways to pay, increasing payment success, strengthening payment reliability, and reducing the cost and operational friction of payments.

To support this mission, Chewy is hiring a Senior Program Manager, Payment Operations and Optimization
in Bellevue, WA, Boston, MA, or Plantation, FL
. This role will report to the Head of Payment Partnerships & Operations and serve as a senior operational owner for complex payment capabilities across Chewy. The role will drive payment performance, operational readiness, partner escalation, incident response, and cross-functional execution across recurring, stored payment, and advanced authorization experiences. This includes Autoship and repeat purchase payment flows, stored credentials, backup payment methods, retries, decline recovery, tokenization, digital wallets, payment method lifecycle management, and scenarios involving multiple authorizations or merchant category code (MCC) configurations.

The ideal candidate is an experienced payments and operations leader who has managed payment outcomes in a scaled ecommerce, fintech, subscription, retail, or omnichannel environment. This person brings strong payments knowledge, senior program leadership, and the ability to connect strategic priorities with hands-on operational execution across complex card-not-present and recurring payment models. They can simplify technical payment topics, identify customer and business impact, and lead cross-functional teams through measurable improvements in payment success, authorization performance, customer retention, and operational reliability. This role is well suited for someone who can partner effectively across Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Legal/Compliance, and external payment partners to improve customer experiences.

What You'll Do

Own the operational health, performance, and optimization roadmap for advanced authorization capabilities, stored payment, and recurring, including multi-authorization flows, multiple MCC configurations, and payment method lifecycle workflows.
Define, monitor, and improve key payment metrics, including payment success rate, authorization performance, retry recovery, decline trends, multi-authorization outcomes, MCC configuration impacts, incident volume, and operational SLA performance.
Serve as the senior payment operations owner for launches, enhancements, defects, partner escalations, operational readiness, and post-launch performance management.
Lead cross-functional programs across Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Legal/Compliance, and external payment partners.
Identify payment defects, reliability risks, and customer friction across complex authorization, stored credential, and recurring flows; quantify customer, operational, and financial impact; and drive prioritized resolution.
Partner with payment processors, wallet providers, tokenization providers, and other third parties to manage operational performance, roadmap dependencies, issue resolution, SLAs, and improvement plans.
Analyze issuer, network, processor, card type, wallet, MCC, tokenization, debit routing, retry, and decline-code trends to identify optimization opportunities.
Build executive-ready narratives, business reviews, and recommendations that connect payment performance, customer experience, retention, cost, risk, and business impact.
Serve as a payments subject matter expert for card-not-present, stored credential, recurring billing, multi-authorization, tokenization, digital wallet, debit routing, MCC, refund, reconciliation, and operational support workflows.

What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, operations, technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of experience in payments, fintech, ecommerce, retail, subscription billing, omnichannel operations, or another scaled operational environment.
5+ years leading complex cross-functional programs with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Customer Care/Operations, Legal/Compliance, and external partners.
Experience supporting complex order and payment scenarios where a single order or customer transaction may require multiple authorizations, MCC configurations, settlement paths, or downstream reconciliation.
Demonstrated experience owning payment KPIs and operational outcomes such as payment success rate, authorization rate, decline rate, retry recovery, backup payment method performance, involuntary churn, dispute rate, reconciliation quality, cost of payments, or operational SLA performance.
Direct experience with card-not-present and recurring payment flows, including processors, acquirers, issuers, card networks, digital wallets, stored credentials, tokenization, account updater, settlement, refunds, disputes, and reconciliation.
Experience supporting ecommerce, subscription, and repeat purchase payment environments where reliability directly affects customer retention and business performance.
Strong analytical capability with the ability to use payment data, processor reporting, decline trends, authorization performance, customer feedback, and operational defects to identify root causes and drive action.
Proven ability to operate in ambiguity, dive deep into details, and lead teams through issue resolution without direct authority.
Strong vendor and partner management experience, including performance reviews, escalations, SLA management, roadmap alignment, and operational improvement plans.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level narratives, business reviews, and decision recommendations.
Ability to deliver time-sensitive initiatives while maintaining strong attention to detail and ownership of follow-through.
Ability to travel up to 15% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with payment models that include multi-authorization flows, multiple MCC configurations, settlement, and reconciliation.
Experience improving authorization performance through issuer, network, processor, card type, tokenization, digital wallet, debit routing, MCC, or decline-code analysis.
Experience launching or scaling payment capabilities that support high-volume stored payment methods.
Experience improving payment observability, operational support models, and partner performance in a high-volume environment.
Experience with card-not-present payment operations, including ecommerce, fintech, subscription, or other complex digital payment workflows.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Recurring, stored payment, and advanced authorization workflows are reliable, measurable, and supported by clear operational mechanisms.
Payment success, authorization performance, and customer retention opportunities are identified quickly, quantified clearly, and improved through strong cross-functional ownership.
Payment partner performance is actively managed through business reviews, escalations, SLAs, and improvement plans.
Senior leaders have a clear view of payment performance, authorization risks, tradeoffs, and investment needs.

The base salary range for this role is $129,500 - $207,000.00.

The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

BAE Systems is seeking a strategic, growth-oriented Program Manager to lead complex USAF sustainment projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for the strategic execution of programs involving the sustainment of legacy USAF avionics and electronic warfare (EW) systems, ensuring that program objectives are seamlessly aligned with the organization's technical roadmap and long-term business strategy.

This role requires a high level of leadership to bridge the gap between operational execution and business growth. The Program Manager will interface with internal experts in Contracts, Subcontracts, Finance, and Purchasing, while engaging directly with government customers and aerospace primes to ensure that financial, schedule, and technical objectives are met through a framework of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

Program Governance & Execution:
Accountable for all aspects of assigned program execution, including cost, schedule, technical performance, quality, and inventory management. Establish a management framework that ensures high-priority objectives are met while promoting efficiencies in readiness and sustainment.

Strategic Leadership & Alignment:
Define program objectives and strategies aligned with customer requirements and BAE Systems' Integrated Business Plan (IBP). Lead cross-functional Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) to ensure that program execution supports the broader strategic technology roadmap.

Customer Engagement & Influence:
Act as the primary focal point between BAE Systems and customer program offices, suppliers, and key stakeholders. Influence and shape requirements to ensure that delivered solutions are innovative, operationally viable, and strategically positioned for future growth.

Business Development & Growth
: Lead capture teams to position the business for wins. Develop robust business cases for new product development and lead the submission of competitive, innovative proposals that expand the customer base and align with strategic growth targets.

Operational Management:
Manage program scope, budget, and critical path scheduling. Oversee the timely start and completion of tasks—specifically prototype fabrication, testing, and qualification—ensuring that technical investments are financially sound and execution is rigorous.

Resource Optimization & Talent Integration:
Ensure the optimum utilization of program resources and external partners. Collaborate with the Lead Engineer to ensure that the program is staffed with the necessary technical competencies to execute complex solutions.

Continuous Improvement:
Share best practices and lessons learned to continuously improve people, processes, and products, fostering a culture of technical and operational excellence.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in a technical or business field.
Experience: 10+ years of demonstrated experience leading diverse, multi-discipline project teams in a high-tempo environment.
Project Management: Proven expertise in program management processes, including program planning, risk and opportunity management, and Earned Value Management (EVM).
Contractual Knowledge: Experience with DoD contract execution, specifically within IDIQ/Task Order environments.
Technical Background: Experience with technical product sustainment (hardware, software, and systems) and reverse engineering/prototyping to resolve sustainment issues.
Strategic Mindset: Demonstrated ability to think strategically with a growth mindset, aligning program execution with corporate business expansion goals.
Interpersonal Skills: Strong presentation, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to resolve conflict and articulate complex messages simply across all levels of the organization.
Tools: Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, specifically high-level experience with Excel and MS Project.
Clearance: Active Secret security clearance is required.

Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills

Certification: Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Financial Systems: Experience with Deltek Costpoint.
Process Improvement: Lean Six-Sigma or general process improvement experience.
Domain Expertise: Familiarity with avionics and EW systems, and DoD acquisition.
Quality Standards: Understanding of AS9145 quality management processes.
Customer Experience: Prior experience working with government customers such as AFSC and PAE Electronic Systems.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $136000 - $231200

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

About BAE Systems Intelligence & Security

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

Job Summary

The Provider Program Manager is responsible for overseeing the design, implementation, and delivery of processes, programs, and policies in an assigned functional area within the provider services departments. The Provider Program Manager ensures that strategic, enterprise-wide programs are well defined, planned, tracked, and communicated in a consistent manner; is responsible for collaborating with C-Suite executives and other stakeholders; and is responsible for deliverables that meet defined requirements and for utilizing project management best practices. The Provider Program Manager will function as both a subject matter expert (SME) and delivery lead and will be assigned to a specific functional area such as value-based care, provider education or credentialing.

Education & Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or other related field, or equivalent experience
U.S. Citizenship
Must be able to receive a favorable Interim and adjudicated final Department of Defense (DoD) background investigation

Demonstrated success in designing, implementing, and delivery of value-based care, provider education or provider credentialing programs
Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with ability to lead and motivate diverse teams
Experience managing vendor/partnership relationships
Experience utilizing Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Access)

jobs.title: Program Manager- Weapon Systems Program Execution
jobs.description:
Job Description

BAE Systems is hiring a Program Manager- Weapon Systems Program Execution to support the Combat Mission Systems (CMS) business. The Program Excellence team provides strategic and thought leadership to Project, Program, and Portfolio Management for the CMS business area with annual sales of approximately $3B and over 200 program managers. This organization serves as a recognized subject matter expert in program management responsible for improving program execution across the enterprise (rather than directly managing a single program). Leveraging extensive experience leading complex, high-risk (“red”) programs, this role partners with program teams to strengthen execution, reduce risk, improve predictability, and drive successful program outcomes. This role provides independent assessments and helps establish best practices across the enterprise. This role also supports the Program Management capability for CMS and improve Program Management Processes, Training, Tools, and Measures. The role will report to the Director of Weapon Systems Program Execution.

Because this role involves a combination of collaborative/in-person and independent work, it will take the form of a hybrid work format, with time split between working onsite and remotely (averaging 3 days onsite weekly).

For this position, we will consider someone working out of Louisville, KY.

Responsibilities

Serve as a subject matter resource to program managers and functional leaders on program execution, planning, and risk management
Provide independent assessments of program health, identifying execution risks and recommending corrective actions before issues impact cost, schedule, or technical performance
Evaluates program baselines, integrated master schedules, earned value performance, staffing plans, and risk registers to ensure realistic executable plans
Serve as an organization lead in program recovery, leveraging firsthand experience leading high-risk (“red”) programs to successful execution
Deploy to critical or underperforming programs to stabilize execution and improve program performance
Identify systemic issues across programs and recommend enterprise improvements to process, governance, training, and tools
Establish and maintain enterprise program management best practices, standard work, and execution playbooks
Facilitate lessons learned and ensure successful practices are captured and implemented across the portfolio
Support proposal teams by providing program execution expertise, transition planning, and execution strategy
Develop metrics and dashboards that provide meaningful insight into program health and execution maturity
Maintain performance excellence within the integrated systems and ensure the planning, architecture, processes, tools, testing, and continuous improvements promote current and future effectiveness
Collaborate and communicate with other program control and execution teams at all levels to evaluate key performance of current cost and schedule integration process and help facilitate change
Promote consistency across all programs within CMS, ensure existing and improved processes remain in compliance with EVMS System Description and DOD Earned Value Management System Interpretation Guide
Support internal and external project control surveillance activities, including working proactively with program teams to prepare/train teams, mock interviews, mitigating risk of discrepancy reports, developing corrective action plans, and driving program teams and the organization to closure on actions
Maintain familiarity with industry practices, trends, and applications to enhance the organization's capabilities
Support cross-sector and BAE Systems, Inc. program management initiatives
Support CMS Program Management in Lifecycle Management

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

Bachelor's Degree and minimum of 8 years leading complex defense, aerospace, or automotive programs
Successful experience recovering or leading high-risk (“red”) programs
Proven track record of recovering underperforming programs by improving cost, schedule, technical performance, customer confidence, and execution predictability
Strong working knowledge of:
Program Management principles
Earned Value Management System (EVMS)
Integrated Master Scheduling and Performance Measurement Baseline (PMB)
Risk and Opportunity Management
Proposal transition and program startup
Government contracting requirements

Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority
Strong communication and presentation skills
Experience leading cross-functional teams in a matrix organization
Experience in Knowledge Management and training large groups/organizations

Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills

Master's Degree
Expertise in Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS)
Expertise in Performance Measurement Baseline (PMB)
Expertise in Data Analytics and Reporting
Experience in Data Visualization, including Power BI
Experience in Defense Contracting
Experience in Training Content development and improvement
Experience in Budgeting and Costing
Experience in Design/Development Programs
Experience in Stage Gate and Design Reviews
Experience in Change Management across different functions

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $120874 - $205486

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

About BAE Systems Platforms & Services

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.

Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

Certifications and Licenses:

Series 7 , 63 or 66 required within 2 years.
Series 65 preferred

Internal Application Policy:

Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP.

Benefits to support you:

Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide)
401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package
Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Kestra Values:

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

Explore Life at Kestra

Kestra Holdings Website: https://www.kestrafinancial.com/

Careers Portal: https://jobs.dayforcehcm.com/en-US/kestra/KESTRACAREERSITE

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/kestra-financial

Apply Today

Lead with purpose. Apply now and help shape the future of Kestra.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to lead and scale service fulfillment and logistics operations in Taiwan. You will design, implement, and continuously improve end-to-end processes for installation, field service fulfillment, parts logistics, returns, and depot repair to meet ambitious SLAs, cost targets, and customer experience goals.

This position is based in Taipei, Taiwan

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead cross-functional programs to operationalize new products, services, and service offerings, ensuring readiness across fulfillment, logistics, field service, and support. Coordinate cross-functional collaborators (product, engineering, sales, finance, customer success) to align service SLAs with commercial commitments.
Design and optimize end-to-end fulfillment flows: order intake, kitting, staging, shipping, installation scheduling, returns, repair, and reverse logistics.
Manage relationships with 3PLs, carriers, depot/repair partners, warehousing teams, and field service providers; negotiate contracts and measure performance.
Define program benchmarks (OTD, SLA compliance, RMA turnaround, inventory turns, shipping cost per unit, fill rate, first-time fix rate) and build dashboards for leadership.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma tools) to reduce cost, cycle time, and failures while increasing capacity and quality.
Develop capacity planning and inventory strategies based on projected demand to support product launches and seasonal demand spikes.
Lead change management: rollout of new systems (WMS, TMS, FSM, ERP integrations), SOPs, training, and governance.
Own risk management and business continuity planning for logistics and field operations (disruption mitigation, contingency carriers, spare pools).

What We Need To See

8+ years of program or operations management experience focused on fulfillment, logistics, field service, or service operations in a high-tech or hardware environment.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in supply chain, Engineering, Business, or related; MBA or relevant certification (CSCP, Six Sigma) preferred.
Proven track record managing complex, cross-functional programs with external partners (3PLs, carriers, repair depots).
Strong data-driven decision-making: experience with benchmark definition, dashboards, and regular operational reviews.
Hands-on experience with WMS/TMS, FSM platforms, and ERP integration projects.
Demonstrated ability to optimize inventory, forecast demand, and manage reverse logistics/RMA processes.
Excellent collaborator management, negotiation, and vendor management skills. Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with tight timelines.
Willingness to travel (up to 25%) and work across Texas time zones as needed.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Strong project management (PMP, Agile) and process improvement capabilities.
Analytical proficiency with SQL, Excel modeling, and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI).
Excellent written/verbal communication, able to present to executive audiences.
Customer-centric approach with a focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement.
Experience scaling operations for rapid growth and new product launches.

jobs.description:
English Version to Follow

Qui sommes-nous?

XNRGY Climate Systems est un chef de file nord-américain dans la conception durable et la fabrication de pointe de systèmes de traitement d'air sur mesure. Axés sur la recherche et le développement énergétique, nous contribuons à la réduction de l'empreinte carbone dans de nombreux secteurs d'activité.

Nous sommes fiers d'annoncer l'ouverture de notre nouveau siège social technologique à Mesa, en Arizona. Cette expansion témoigne de notre engagement envers la croissance, l'innovation et le développement de solutions climatiques durables.

L'opportunité

Aperçu du poste

Le ou la gestionnaire du programme de produits est un leader clé de l’exécution responsable de coordonner l’ensemble du cycle de vie de systèmes thermiques sur mesure à haut rendement, depuis le lancement de la commande jusqu’à la préparation à l’expédition. Agissant comme lien essentiel entre la conception et la livraison physique du produit, cette personne assure l’exécution interfonctionnelle entre les équipes d’Ingénierie, de Fabrication, de Chaîne d’approvisionnement, de Logistique et de Qualité.

La personne idéale ne se contente pas d’assurer le suivi des tâches; elle prend en charge les risques liés aux programmes, favorise la préparation opérationnelle, remet en question les écarts d’exécution et garantit que les engagements pris envers les clients sont livrés à temps, dans le respect du budget et selon les plus hauts standards de qualité.

Principales responsabilités – Incluant, sans s’y limiter

Définir et diriger la stratégie d’exécution de bout en bout pour plusieurs projets complexes et à forte valeur ajoutée, de l’étude de faisabilité initiale jusqu’à la préparation à l’expédition, tout en protégeant les échéanciers, la qualité et les marges.
Valider la faisabilité de l’exécution avant l’engagement interne des programmes, notamment en ce qui concerne le réalisme des échéanciers, la maturité de l’ingénierie et les contraintes de fabrication.
Remettre en question l’état de préparation de l’ingénierie et exercer l’autorité nécessaire pour interrompre la progression lorsqu’une conception n’a pas atteint le niveau de maturité requis pour la production.
Assurer une préparation complète à la production, incluant l’exactitude des nomenclatures (BOM), la disponibilité des matériaux et la capacité des ressources; superviser les étapes critiques de validation telles que les essais d’acceptation en usine (FAT) et les inspections qualité.
Diriger la gouvernance complète des programmes, incluant les rencontres quotidiennes d’alignement de l’exécution, les réunions hebdomadaires de coordination interfonctionnelle et les rapports mensuels destinés à la direction.
Agir comme point central de l’exécution à travers l’organisation en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes des Ventes, de l’Approvisionnement, de l’Ingénierie, de la Qualité, de la Production et du Service sur le terrain afin d’assurer une discipline opérationnelle rigoureuse, du lancement de la commande à la livraison finale.
Contribuer à la définition, au déploiement et à l’amélioration continue des outils, modèles et standards d’exécution en gestion de programmes produits chez XNRGY.

Qualifications Requises

Baccalauréat en génie, en gestion de la construction, en gestion des opérations ou dans un domaine technique connexe.
Plus de 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de projets ou de programmes dans un environnement complexe, idéalement dans les secteurs manufacturier, industriel ou CVAC (HVAC).
Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de programmes complexes comprenant plusieurs projets et des budgets de plusieurs millions de dollars, avec une responsabilité claire quant à la stratégie du programme et à la reddition de comptes auprès de la haute direction.
Excellente capacité à mobiliser, aligner et responsabiliser des équipes matricielles et interfonctionnelles sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
Solide sens des affaires et aptitude démontrée à équilibrer les risques, les coûts et les échéanciers afin de prendre des décisions stratégiques sous pression et dans des délais serrés.

Qualifications Privilégiées

Maîtrise en génie, en gestion de projets, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
Certification PMP (Project Management Professional), Lean Six Sigma, PRINCE2 ou toute autre certification reconnue en gestion de programmes et en résolution de problèmes.
Expérience dans les secteurs des centrales de traitement d’air sur mesure, de la gestion thermique ou du refroidissement liquide, particulièrement pour des environnements critiques comme les centres de données hyperscale, les établissements de santé ou les salles blanches.
Expérience démontrée dans le déploiement ou la mise à l’échelle de cadres de gouvernance de bureau de gestion de projets (PMO) et de modèles opérationnels au sein d’une organisation en forte croissance et en transformation.
Expérience directe des cycles d’introduction de nouveaux produits (NPI) ou de la transition de prototypes sur mesure vers des processus de fabrication standardisés.

Pourquoi joindre XNRGY?

Chez XNRGY Climate Systems, nous sommes déterminés à créer un environnement de travail inclusif où la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives favorise l'innovation et la réussite.

Nous recherchons des personnes passionnées par le développement durable, désireuses de contribuer à un avenir plus respectueux de l'environnement.

XNRGY Climate Systems is a North American leader in sustainable design and advanced manufacturing of custom air handling systems. Focused on energy research and development, we help reduce the carbon footprint across many industries.

We are proud to announce the opening of our new technology headquarters in Mesa, Arizona. This expansion reflects our commitment to growth, innovation, and the development of sustainable climate solutions.

At XNRGY Climate Systems, we are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where diversity of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives drives innovation and success.

jobs.title: ASIC Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference
. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary

Etched is seeking a highly skilled and motivated ASIC Technical Program Manager to join our silicon team. This is a hands-on, high-accountability role for someone who has lived inside the ASIC development cycle and can drive technical execution, not just track it. You will own program coordination across Physical Design, DFT, DV, and RTL teams while managing relationships with external vendors including IP providers, implementation partners, and EDA tool vendors. The ideal candidate has real tape-out experience, understands the full RTL-to-GDSII flow, and operates with the urgency and proactivity that a first-silicon program demands.

Key Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Technical Coordination: Own program management across Physical Design, DFT, DV, RTL, and Post-Silicon teams. Understand inter-team dependencies - know who owns what, when handoffs need to happen, and what needs to be signed off before downstream work can begin (e.g., RTL version gates for synthesis, DFT insertion checkpoints, ECO cycles).
Vendor Management: Engage directly with external vendors, including EDA partners and implementation partners. Hold vendors accountable to timelines and deliverables. Be prepared to push back, defend Etched’s technical requirements, and escalate when needed.
Risk Identification and Mitigation: Proactively surface critical path risks, schedule slippage, and cross-team blockers. Develop mitigation strategies in partnership with engineering leads and escalate appropriately to technical and executive stakeholders.
Project Planning and Execution: Manage the scheduling and execution of complex, multi-team hardware programs. Keep projects on track across tape-out milestones, synthesis respins, and signoff cycles.
Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular, clear updates to engineering leads, VP-level stakeholders, and executive leadership on project status, risks, and decisions required. Set the tone for meetings, facilitate alignment, mediate technical disagreements, and drive to decisions.
Process Coordination: Work with ops and engineering teams to maintain accurate tracking of program state, action owners, and open items. Support the adoption of tooling and dashboards that improve engineering visibility - though dashboard creation itself sits with the ops team.
Technical Acumen: Bring enough ASIC domain knowledge to communicate credibly with engineers across the design stack and with external partners. You don’t need to be a designer, but you need to know the difference between a .3 and .5 RTL release, understand where DFT fits in the flow, and have a feel for what a synthesis restart actually involves.

You may be a good fit if you have (Must-have qualifications)

At least one full ASIC tape-out under your belt. You should be able to speak fluently to what that process looks like end-to-end.
Solid understanding of the RTL-to-GDSII flow, including where Physical Design, DFT, DV, and RTL teams intersect and hand off to each other.
5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related role within the semiconductor or hardware space.
Experience working directly with external EDA vendors or implementation partners - you’ve been in those rooms and know how to hold your ground.
Exceptional follow-through and proactivity. You chase down dependencies; you don’t wait for them to surface.
Strong communication and facilitation skills - you set a productive tone in meetings, keep discussions on track, and bring people to alignment.
Comfort with fast-paced, ambiguous startup environments where priorities shift and programs evolve quickly.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
$500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office
Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)
Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more
Daily lunch and dinner in our office
Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

How We’re Different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Information Security team at Shine

At Shine, our Security team operates as a strategic driver rather than a support function.
We work directly with leadership to integrate resilience into the company’s core, navigating the complex intersection of cloud-native architecture, AI innovation, and rigorous regulatory standards
like DORA and ISO 27001. By partnering cross-functionally with Engineering and Risk, we aren’t just maintaining a perimeter; we are building a scalable, high-visibility security framework that defines the future of digital operational excellence in the fintech space.

Your Role as a Cyber Security Manager at Shine

Shine Bank is looking for an Cyber Security Manager
to help shape and operate our information security and digital operational resilience framework. Reporting directly to the CISO
, you will take a key role in implementing and maturing our Cyber Defence capabilities
in close collaboration with IT, Risk, Internal Audit and Management. As Cyber Security Manager, you will own our defensive security technology stack and our incident-readiness capability.

Your Responsibilities

Own, evaluate, and continuously improve our defensive security technology stack — EDR/XDR, DDoS protection, vulnerability management, DLP, and endpoint hardening.
Ensure robust DDoS protection across our internet-facing and payment-critical services — selecting and managing mitigation solutions (e.g. Cloudflare, Akamai, AWS Shield) validating that protection holds up to the availability expectations regulators place on a payment institution.
Design, write, and maintain incident response playbooks for our most relevant scenarios aligned with DORA ICT incident-management expectations.
Plan and facilitate regular tabletop exercises and simulations across technical, operational, and executive stakeholders; capture findings and drive remediation to closure.
Partner with the SOC Manager to ensure tooling supports detection and response use cases (mapped to MITRE ATT&CK).
Provide the technical evidence and control assurance the Information Security (GRC) function needs for PCI-DSS, DORA, and ACPR-related obligations.
Manage security vendor and MSSP relationships, contribute to the security technology roadmap and budget, and translate threat intelligence into concrete control improvements.
Report on resilience metrics and the effectiveness of deployed controls to security leadership.

📍 Job located in Berlin or Madrid office, with possibility of two remote working days per week

About You

Hands-on background in technical / engineering security operations, ideally within regulated financial services, payments, or fintech.
Practical experience deploying and operating EDR/XDR platforms (e.g. CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender) and other core defensive tooling.
Hands-on experience with DDoS mitigation and edge/CDN security (e.g. Cloudflare, Akamai, AWS Shield/WAF) and an understanding of how to protect high-availability, customer-facing services.
Demonstrated incident response experience — you have built playbooks and run tabletop exercises, not just read about them.
Working knowledge of DORA, PCI-DSS, NIS2 and MITRE ATT&CK.
Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills, with the ability to bridge technical detail and business risk.
Fluent English required; German is a strong advantage.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery. We deliver high-resolution thermal insights that help governments, defense agencies, and agribusinesses better manage water resources, agricultural production, national security threats, and critical infrastructure.

We grow through two distinct routes to market – government programmes, and commercial data and subscription products – and our Operations team keeps the business running behind both, giving executive leadership a clear, trusted view of how the company is performing.

We are looking for an Operations Analyst
to join our Operations team and work closely with our Chief of Corporate Operations. You will help plan, coordinate, and build financial and operational models. You will also help support analysis and strategy proposals that inform how Hydrosat runs its business – from employee compensation and departmental planning, to ESG, ERM, and other org-wide efforts. You will support organization of the efficiency metrics that tell leadership where the company stands, as well as the implementation processes that result. Using Excel, PowerPoint, AI, and other tools of the trade you will turn complex, cross-functional data and workflows into clear analysis and presentation decks that senior leadership and department heads can act on, and will help with coordination and implementation across departments for such programs.

This is not a narrow reporting role. We expect our Senior Operations Analyst to be a genuine thought partner to the CCO and executive leadership – helping structure how the company thinks about its own performance, not just producing the numbers. The ideal candidate is as comfortable, for example, building a compensation model from scratch as they are distilling it into a clear, well-organized narrative for a monthly business review.

Responsibilities May Include But Are Not Limited To

Act as a flexible operations resource to the CCO, picking up cross-functional analysis, coordination, and projects as priorities shift
Build clear, well-structured Excel models and PowerPoint presentations that make complex operational and financial topics easy for leadership to act on
Prepare and help coordinate and run monthly revenue reviews, business reviews, and other leadership initiatives with the CCO, department leads and executive leadership
Partner closely with the CCO and executive leadership on corporate operations, business planning, and company financial topics
Build and maintain models and plans which may range from ERM, to ESG, OKRs, KPIs, supporting benchmarking, budgeting, and compensation planning decisions, among other key areas of org infrastructure
Help define and track efficiency metrics across departments, giving leadership a consistent way to measure how the business is performing
Support departmental modelling and planning, working with department leads to support the build-out and refinement oftheir operating plans
Develop financial and compensation models that hold up to scrutiny from leadership, the board, and investors

Job Requirements

Strong facility with Excel modelling and building polished, executive-ready PowerPoint presentations
Experience in corporate operations, business operations, or corporate finance, ideally including exposure to complex company structural and/or financing topics
A structured, organized way of thinking – you don't need to be the one presenting, but your analysis needs to tell a clear story
Comfortable working closely to support a CCO (and where needed other executive leadership directly), with thecoordination skills, judgment and discretion that requires
Ability to naturally multitask and work across a broad array of professional topics, considerations, time-zones, and other diverse daily work requirements
Excellent written and analytical communication skills
Eligible to work in the United States

Ideal Profile

Exposure to both large company and a small company priorities and underlying realities – for example, starting a career at a larger organization before moving to a startup and helping build something from scratch (or vice-versa)
A “spirit of organization and presentation”: someone who naturally organizes their thinking into a clear structure, even if presenting it to a room isn't the main part of the role, though there will be future opportunities for this as well
Comfortable working remotely as part of a distributed team; candidates based on the US East Coast are preferred

Background in a startup or scale-up environment, having helped build an operations or similar function from the ground up
Experience supporting a C-level executive or executive leadership team directly
Exposure to the space, geospatial, Earth observation, or another deep-tech industry
Hands-on experience building departmental planning, efficiency, or compensation models

jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
What The Role Is

ISD confronts and addresses threats to Singapore’s internal security and stability. For over 75 years, ISD and its predecessor organisations have played a central role in countering threats such as those posed by foreign subversive elements, spies, racial and religious extremists, and terrorists. A fulfilling and rewarding career awaits those who want to join in ISD’s critical mission of keeping Singapore safe, secure and sovereign for all Singaporeans.

What You Will Be Working On

The Intelligence Analyst has to process information gathered through a variety of sources (e.g. open source reporting, investigations, etc.), synthesising and crystallising these into timely, useful and actionable intelligence. A core part of an Intelligence Analyst’s work is sense-making. You will have to make sense and paint a coherent picture of developments which are at times complex and conflicting, identify information gaps, assess security implications and anticipate developing threats. As an Intelligence Analyst, you will undertake different aspects of analysis, such as operational analysis, strategic analysis and policy analysis. In operational analysis, you will provide support for investigations to neutralise security threats. You will also be involved in strategic analysis, which entails broader and longer-term monitoring of trends to identify threats and make sound security assessments. In policy analysis, you will examine policies that have an impact on internal security, to provide an accurate assessment of implications and make recommendations on how best to safeguard Singapore’s security interests. Given the complex and rapidly-evolving security terrain, your work will be fast-paced, challenging and stimulating.

What We Are Looking For

Degree in any discipline or equivalent competencies
Strong analytical ability – able to process large volumes of information to surface pertinent security points/trends, develop insights into security threats on the horizon, and distil the implications for Singapore’s internal security
Meticulous with an eye for detail
Keen interest in current affairs and security issues
Strong writing skills – competent in drafting clear and succinct reports
Able to work independently, as well as in a team
Useful to have good communication and presentation skills
Only Singaporeans need apply
