jobs.title: Cleared Senior/Principal R&D Technical Targeting Intelligence Analyst, Onsite
jobs.description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
Extraordinary co-workers
Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

We are seeking an experienced intelligence analyst to play a critical role in countering emerging national security threats by partnering with subject matter experts to conduct in-depth technical analysis of intelligence data from multiple sources. Your work will focus on evaluating hard and advanced technologies and associated capabilities, such as specialized infrastructure and research pipelines, to provide actionable insights that support U.S. intelligence community and Department of War objectives.

This position supports both technical and policy customers within the intelligence community. To ensure your success, we provide formal and informal training during onboarding and throughout your growth in the role.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong aptitude for learning, a proactive ¿can-do¿ attitude, comfort working in ambiguity and applying engineering judgement, proactive, and effective collaboration skills. You will work on a dynamic cadence that includes urgent same-day requests as well as longer-term projects spanning several months.

On any given day, you may be called on to:

All-Source Technical Analysis

Conduct comprehensive all-source intelligence analysis on technical topics, synthesizing information from various sources including SIGINT, HUMINT, OSINT, MASINT, and GEOINT into clear analytic messages.
Work comfortably with limited and evolving information to make engineering judgements across various levels of rigor and effectively communicate uncertainties.
Work comfortably outside your field of expertise while still providing grounded technical insights either by self-learning or through building and collaborating with a network of experts across Sandia National Laboratories.
Understand U.S. IC tradecraft standards and how to tailor information to your final products.
Understand and tailor your work to the needs of intelligence end-users in scope, focus, and delivery method.

Analytic Review

Conduct analytic reviews outside your area of technical expertise to evaluate the quality and relevance of findings, ensuring analyses are robust, accurate, appropriately caveated, and aligned with customer needs.
Use critical thinking and analytic techniques to assess source validity and information reliability.

Communication

Produce clear, concise, and well-structured findings across a variety of report templates tailored to high-level customers.
Ensure written products meet established standards and deadlines.
Prepare and deliver briefings to internal and external partners, communicating complex technical information clearly.

Collaboration

Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, fostering teamwork and shared objectives, including federal sponsors, intelligence community partners, technical experts, scientists, and technologists.

Leadership

Foster a positive and collaborative team environment by proactively seeking opportunities to shape future initiatives and partnerships, while contributing to continuous improvement of yourself and others.

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite 100% of the time.

Qualified candidates may be asked to provide a writing sample (500 words or more) prior to any scheduled interviews.

Applicants on this requisition may be interviewed by multiple organizations at Sandia National Laboratories.

Salary Range

$117,500 - $235,700

Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and five (5) years of directly relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development.
Active SCI clearance required to start.
Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q security clearance.

Qualifications We Desire

The ideal R&D Systems Research and Analysis candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

Graduate degree in a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
The ability to understand, synthesize, and draw insights from multiple types of data streams (e.g., technical, economic, policy) through the use of various analytical tools.
Experience working as part of multi-disciplinary teams examining complex systems.
Knowledge of the fundamentals of good project management, especially as it pertains to the execution of federally-funded work (e.g., proposal development through annal review, final delivery, and closeout).
Experience working with federal sponsors in the defense and intelligence sectors, as well as their domestic FFRDC partners, international partnering agencies, and foreign governments.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams delivering critical information to customers in a succinct manner.

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

Experience working in the intelligence community, especially in a role requiring the analysis of disparate streams of data to provide insights into emerging threats and evaluate risks and opportunities.
Demonstrated understanding of the intelligence cycle, including planning, collection, processing, analysis, and dissemination.
Experience briefing senior officials and stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to produce clear, well-organized technical documentation and communicate findings succinctly.
Proven track record of proactively managing responsibilities, taking ownership, and delivering results reliably.
Demonstrated ability to apply sound technical judgements outside of area of expertise through cultivation of relationships with other subject matter experts and self-learning.
Demonstrated leadership potential with emphasis on teamwork, initiative, and workplace improvement.
Adaptability to changing priorities.

About Our Team

The primary mission of the Threat Assessments Group (5920) is to assess the threats posed to US national security interests by foreign advanced weapons and technological capabilities, with emphasis on nuclear weapons. Our analyses inform policymakers and senior officials across the US government responsible for understanding the threats and risks posed by these weapons and relevant technologies. This high impact program area is steadily growing and stewards key capabilities associated with all-source intelligence analysis, computational modeling, and engineering studies.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) SCI security clearance to start, or equivalent active security clearance with another U.S. government agency (e.g., DOD). Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance and SCI access, both of which require US citizenship. SCI access may also require a polygraph examination. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain these levels of access may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by the DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

Eeo

About Khan Academy

Khan Academy is a fast-paced, nonprofit startup on a mission to provide a free, world-class education for anyone, anywhere. We already reach millions of students every month and are growing rapidly. We’re building a library of world-class instructional and practice resources that empowers learners. Whether they’re studying matrices, mitosis, or multivariable calculus, we want to offer students the resources to realize that they can learn anything.

About Khan Academy India

Khan Academy India aims to deliver a world class user experience that is locally relevant to learners in India and is enabled by a strong on-the-ground team and operations. Our learning system is mastery based, which allows students to master key concepts at a pace that is right for them before moving on to more challenging content. From serving under 500,000 learners in 2016, we are now serving almost 4 million learners a month across our websites, apps and youtube channels. These learners include both independent learners accessing us at home and teacher directed learners in schools. Our focus is to reach the underserved by making our content accessible in local languages and by working with large public school systems. Khan Academy is available in Hinglish, Hindi, Gujarati, Assamese, Marathi, Punjabi and Kannada.

About The Role

We are looking for a person who will help us with data management, transformation, analysis and visualization. The primary focus will be on choosing optimal tools to use for these purposes and then maintaining, implementing, and monitoring them. Optimally you have knowledge of at least one dynamic language and SQL, a good business mindset, and data analysis competencies.

Please note that this is a 12-months contract role
, subject to extension further.

Data Integration: Automate ingestion of data from multiple sources (e.g., Google Sheets, APIs, internal systems) into BigQuery

KPI Definition & Tracking: Partner with stakeholders to define key business metrics and create systems for daily, weekly and monthly tracking as needed
Data Storytelling: Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences

About You

You are someone with:

Experience with Education or EdTech industry is strongly preferred
A willingness to roll up your sleeves and help the team get work done as we are growing
4+ years of hands on experience in data analytics field, ideally in an education setting
Knowledge of advanced statistical (i.e. multiple regression, hypothesis testing) and machine learning techniques (i.e. clustering, decision tree learning, etc.) for real-world applications
Strong SQL foundations & ability to manipulate data using R or Python
Prior experience with the end-to-end analytics chain is a nice to have (e.g. data modeling, BI tools, Bigquery)
Strong verbal/written communication & data presentation skills, including an ability to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams, experience with BI tools is a plus
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to research and improve our content and products
Being aware of good practices when collaborating in version control (Git)

Perks And Benefits

We may be a non-profit, but we reward our talented team like a for-profit.

Competitive salaries and Meritocracy-driven, candid culture
A fun, high-caliber team that trusts you and gives you the freedom to be brilliant
The ability to put your talents towards a deeply meaningful mission and the opportunity to work on high-impact products that are already defining the future of education

About Cystematic Cystematic is a cybersecurity, digital trust and technology advisory firm operating across offensive security, defensive security, digital forensics, AI security and cyber risk.
Our security assessments are designed to move beyond automated scanning: we combine technical analysis, adversarial thinking, manual validation and evidence-based reporting to identify vulnerabilities that materially affect applications, infrastructure and digital services.

to join our offensive security practice and support the assessment of modern web and mobile applications.

engagements.

, with exposure to web applications, APIs and supporting backend infrastructure.

What You Will Do Support VAPT engagements for Android and iOS applications
, web applications and APIs.
Perform reconnaissance, attack-surface mapping and application security analysis.
Conduct manual and tool-assisted testing for authentication, authorization, session management, input validation, cryptography, insecure storage, network communication, platform interaction and other application security weaknesses.
Apply the OWASP Top 10
as a foundational reference for web application security testing.
Understand and apply the OWASP Mobile Application Security Verification Standard (MASVS)
when assessing mobile security controls.
Use the OWASP Mobile Application Security Testing Guide (MASTG)
to understand appropriate testing methodologies, techniques and test cases for Android and iOS.
Develop a practical understanding of MASWE
and how mobile weaknesses relate to MASVS controls and MASTG testing.
Assist with static and dynamic analysis of mobile applications.
Analyse Android and iOS application architectures, permissions, components, storage mechanisms, IPC, deep links, WebViews, networking, authentication and platform security controls.
Support testing for common mobile weaknesses including insecure data storage, weak cryptographic implementation, insecure communication, improper authentication/authorization, exported components, insecure WebViews, deep-link abuse, certificate-validation weaknesses, insufficient platform controls and inadequate resilience against tampering or reverse engineering.
Assist with application/API testing using tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, JADX, apktool, Frida, MobSF
and appropriate platform-specific tooling.
Validate findings manually rather than relying solely on scanner output.
Capture reproducible evidence, technical observations and remediation guidance.
Contribute to professional VAPT reports, technical findings and executive-level summaries.
Maintain awareness of emerging application and mobile security vulnerabilities, attack techniques and defensive controls.

or a related discipline; final-year students with strong practical capability are encouraged to apply
.

, internship experience, security research, bug bounty work, lab environments or equivalent practical exposure may be considered.

Practical familiarity with Linux
and command-line environments.
Fundamental understanding of Android architecture
and Android application components.

, application structure and the iOS security model.
Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10
and the purpose of application security testing methodologies.

, including an understanding of what they are used for and how they guide mobile application security assessments.
Basic understanding of static analysis, dynamic analysis, reverse engineering and vulnerability validation.
Familiarity with HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, JSON, TLS and client-server architectures.
Ability to document technical findings clearly and communicate security issues logically.

, but relevant credentials are advantageous, including:
eMAPT, CEH, Security+, eJPT, PNPT
or comparable application-security, penetration-testing or cybersecurity certifications.
Practical ability will be valued over certification accumulation.

Experience with Burp Suite, Frida, JADX, apktool, MobSF or similar tooling
.
CTF participation, bug bounty research, security write-ups or personal security research.
Understanding of mobile reverse engineering and instrumentation.
Ability to read and understand basic Java/Kotlin, Swift/Objective-C, JavaScript, Python or similar code.
Familiarity with API security and the OWASP API Security Top 10
.
A genuine interest in understanding why a vulnerability exists rather than simply identifying it.

Interim Treasury Project Manager

9-12 Month Contract
Day Rate (Inside IR35 Only)
London, UK

Our client is seeking an experienced Interim Treasury Project Manager to establish and lead a new Treasury Back-Office function. This is a unique opportunity to build new processes, controls and ways of working from the ground up, ensuring robust governance and operational excellence across treasury activities.

The role is responsible for embedding a strong control environment across treasury operations, including settlements, payment execution, reconciliations, banking administration and treasury system processes. The successful candidate will help build a scalable operating model that supports the organisation's future growth.

Key Responsibilities

Establish and lead the organisation's Treasury Back-Office function, embedding robust processes, controls and governance to support a standalone treasury operating model.
Ensure the timely and accurate settlement of treasury transactions, payment execution, reconciliations and banking administration activities.
Maintain a strong controls environment, ensuring compliance with internal policies, audit requirements and regulatory expectations.
Identify, escalate and resolve control issues, driving a culture of accountability and risk awareness across treasury activities.
Oversee day-to-day treasury operational activities, ensuring efficient, effective and well-controlled processes.
Drive continuous improvement through process simplification, standardisation and automation.
Support the development and enhancement of treasury policies, procedures and operating standards.
Ensure bank mandates, signatory arrangements and treasury documentation remain accurate and up to date, noting that Group Treasury retains the governance framework and signatory authority.
Drive the adoption of technology-enabled solutions to enhance efficiency, control and scalability across treasury operations.
Lead, coach and develop the Treasury Back-Office team, creating a high-performing and collaborative environment. Build strong relationships internally and external banking partners.
Coordinate workflows, deliverables and timelines across locations, role modelling strong, values-led leadership throughout delivery.

Candidate Requirements

A professional treasury qualification (ACT) and/or accounting qualification is desirable but not essential.
Significant Treasury Operations experience within an international organisation, ideally within an industry with high-volume transactions
Strong understanding of Treasury Controls & Governance, ideally with experience in implementing and developing new control processes for a business.
Experience working with Treasury Management Systems (ideally FIS Integrity)
Strong understanding of end-to-end Treasury Operations, including settlements, confirmations, payments and reconciliations, along with working knowledge of governance frameworks and risk managmeent principles

👩 💻 The role

We're looking for a sharp, hungry analyst to join the data team at Headout. This is a foundational role, you'll work closely with senior analysts and leadership to build the reports, dashboards, and automations that power decisions across the company.

Depending on where the need is greatest and where your strengths lie, you could find yourself working on growth and marketing analytics, product analytics, operations and supply-side problems, or a mix of all three. The common thread: you'll be embedded in the business, working on problems that matter.

This isn't about crunching numbers in a corner. You'll understand how our marketplace works, why metrics move, and what levers actually drive outcomes. You'll ship real work within your first week, and own meaningful workstreams within your first few months.

If you're someone who gets restless when you're not learning, who'd rather figure things out than wait for instructions, and who cares about craft, this is for you.

🤩 What makes this role special?

Real problems, not busywork
: Headout is a global marketplace operating across dozens of cities, thousands of experiences, multiple currencies, real-time inventory, and dynamic pricing. Whether you're analyzing conversion funnels, attribution models, supplier economics, or product experiments, the problems here are genuinely hard.
Breadth of exposure
: You won't be siloed into one corner of the business. You'll see how growth, product, operations, and finance interconnect and build the analytical muscle to work across all of them.
Learn fast by doing
: You'll pair with senior analysts on complex projects, get direct feedback from leadership, and see your work influence actual decisions. The feedback loops are tight, and the growth curve is steep.
A team that gives a damn
: We care about speed and pragmatism over perfection, but we don't ship sloppy work. Feedback is direct and frequent. We document what we learn. We help each other get better.
A product you can care about
: Headout helps people experience the best of every city they visit. There's something satisfying about working on a product where the output is someone having a great day somewhere new.

💝 What skills & experience do you need?

1 - 3 years in an analytics, BI, or data science role
Strong SQL skills, you can write complex joins, window functions, CTEs without hand-holding. You know how to debug a slow query.
Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation, automation, or simple analysis
Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI)

Bonus: exposure to marketplace/e-commerce, consumer tech

Introduction

University of the People (UoPeople) is the first non-profit, tuition-free, American, accredited, 100% online university. Today, UoPeople has over 170,000 students enrolled from more than 200 countries and territories, including 18,800 students who are refugees. UoPeople is accredited by the WASC Senior College and University Commission (WSCUC).
We believe that higher education is a basic human right and that it can transform not only the lives of students, but also their families’ lives, their communities, their nations, and, by extension, the world. See President Reshef’s TED Talk when he announced the founding of the University.
UoPeople is an innovative university, and we welcome team members who bring creativity and innovation to their roles. We’re a fast-paced organization with remote teams all around the globe. If you’re a self-starter who wants to succeed alongside a passionate team, we’d love to hear from you!
UoPeople is supported by the generosity of individuals and foundations, including the Gates, Hewlett, Ford Foundations, Foundation Hoffmann, and others. The University has been covered by The New York Times, BBC, NPR, Times Higher Education, U.S. News & World Report, and many other leading media outlets. President Reshef’s TED Talk and Nas Daily interview about the University have more than 30 million combined views

General purpose

The Project Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of assigned strategic initiatives within the University’s Program Management Office (PMO).
Reporting to the Senior Program Manager, PMO Lead, the Project Manager will support a portfolio of strategic initiatives spanning Product, Technology, Operations, and other cross-functional workstreams. The role will work closely with Product, Technology, business leaders, and other stakeholders to establish clear plans, coordinate dependencies, manage risks, and ensure projects are delivered against agreed scope, timelines, and PMO governance standards.
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive project management professional who is comfortable managing multiple concurrent initiatives in a fast-paced, global, remote environment. The successful candidate will bring strong ownership, structured execution, clear communication, and the ability to drive accountability across teams without direct authority.

Essential functions & responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution
– Own the end-to-end delivery of assigned projects within the PMO portfolio, from planning and initiation through execution, monitoring, and closure. Ensure projects remain aligned with agreed objectives, scope, timelines, and expected outcomes.

Project Planning & Tracking
– Build and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, workstreams, and dependency maps. Ensure project information remains accurate and current throughout the project lifecycle.

Project Health & Reporting
– Monitor project health and provide regular RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status reporting for assigned initiatives. Identify emerging risks, issues, blockers, and scope changes and ensure appropriate actions are taken.

Cross-Functional Coordination
– Coordinate closely with Product, Technology, Operations, and other workstream leads to ensure deliverables are clearly defined, appropriately sequenced, and delivered on time.

Stakeholder Management –
Establish effective working relationships with stakeholders across the University, including senior leaders, business drivers, Product and Technology teams, and other functional partners. Drive alignment and accountability across teams and stakeholders outside the direct reporting line.

Project Governance & Meetings
– Facilitate structured project touchpoints, including project check-ins, initial alignment meetings with Business Drivers and executives, and other governance meetings. Ensure decisions, risks, action items, and ownership are clearly documented and followed through.

Project Intake & Scoping
– Support the intake and initial scoping of new project requests. Ensure requests are appropriately documented, logged, assessed, and routed through established PMO governance processes.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management –
Proactively identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints. Escalate material risks, resourcing gaps, unresolved dependencies, or scope concerns in a timely and well-documented manner.

Project Documentation & PMO Standards
– Maintain high-quality project documentation, including project records, project plans, status logs, meeting notes,
decision logs, action trackers, and project summaries. Ensure documentation consistently meets PMO standards.

Project Management Tools & Systems
– Maintain accurate project information within the team’s project planning and tracking tools, including workflows, boards, milestones, status fields, and other PMO tracking mechanisms.

PMO Continuous Improvement
– Contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO tools, templates, governance practices, reporting standards, and project management processes.
Key competencies

· Project Delivery & Execution
– Strong ability to plan, organize, and drive projects from initiation through completion while maintaining focus on scope, timelines, dependencies, and outcomes.

· Organization & Attention to Detail
– Highly structured and detail-oriented, with strong discipline in maintaining accurate project plans, documentation, tracking, and reporting.

· Stakeholder Management & Collaboration
– Builds effective relationships across functions and works confidently with stakeholders outside the direct reporting line to achieve shared objectives.

· Communication & Executive Reporting
– Communicates clearly and proactively, with the ability to translate complex project information into concise, structured updates appropriate for different audiences.
· Risk & Problem Management
– Identifies risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies early and takes appropriate action to resolve or escalate them.

· Accountability & Ownership
– Takes full ownership of assigned projects and confidently holds stakeholders accountable for agreed timelines, deliverables, and actions.

· Adaptability & Prioritization
– Effectively manages competing priorities and changing requirements while maintaining visibility of overall project health and critical deliverables.

· Continuous Improvement Mindset
– Identifies opportunities to improve project management processes, tools, templates, and ways of working across the PMO.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in business, project management, technology, operations, or a related field required.
· 4+ years of progressive experience in project management, ideally within a PMO, technology, Product, or cross-functional operations environment.
· Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities, dependencies, and deadlines.
· MBA, PMP, or equivalent project management certification preferred.
· Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured project updates and reports for different audiences.
· Demonstrated ability to work independently and effectively in a global, remote, and distributed team environment.
· Experience coordinating and influencing stakeholders outside the direct reporting line, including Product, Technology, and business teams.
· Hands-on experience with Jira or equivalent project and work-tracking tools preferred; training can be provided.
· Experience working within higher education, EdTech, or a similarly regulated or academic environment preferred.
· Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies alongside traditional project management and governance practices preferred.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

· Projects are delivered on time, within agreed scope, and aligned with initiative objectives.
· Project plans, milestones, dependencies, and status information are accurate and consistently up to date.
· Risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies are identified early and proactively managed.
· Stakeholders receive timely, clear, and effective communication on project progress and risks.
· Project decisions and action items are documented, assigned clear ownership, and tracked through completion.
· Multiple concurrent projects are managed effectively without compromising quality or PMO standards.
· Project governance, documentation, and reporting consistently meet established PMO expectations.
· The Project Manager independently drives execution, creates accountability, and ensures cross-functional teams remain aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Job description for Project Manager - Change

The Joint Asset Management and Engineering Solutions (JAMES) is a mission-critical Defence information system supporting over 40,000 users and millions of equipment records across Defence. As a key enabler of Asset and Engineering Management, JAMES plays a vital role in supporting Whole Fleet Management across the Defence enterprise.

We are looking for a JAMES Project Manager - Change to plan, coordinate and deliver change activities that enable the successful adoption of new business, security, safety and regulatory changes within JAMES. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the evolution of a critical Defence capability, ensuring change is effectively governed, aligned to organisational objectives and delivers measurable benefits.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing complex information systems change, ensuring technology-enabled initiatives are successfully delivered whilst balancing stakeholder needs, risks and dependencies. You will work closely with a wide range of stakeholders to understand requirements, coordinate change activity and specialise in project management supporting the implementation of change requests. Success in the role will depend on your ability to consider the impact of change across people, processes and technology, using data-driven insights to inform decision-making and ensure sustainable adoption.

Working in partnership with the Lead Engineer, you will ensure the JAMES Adaptive Change Programme remains current and continues to meet safety and legislative policy. You will play an important role in maintaining and enhancing the system's ability to support Asset and Engineering Management activities across Defence, ensuring it continues to meet the needs of Whole Fleet Management.

Please note that due to the nature of the role, regular attendance on site at Battlesbury Barracks, Warminster, Wiltshire, BA12 9DT will be required. You should expect to attend this duty station at a minimum of one to two days per week, with additional attendance expected based on project requirements.

What you’ll be doing

Define and implement the JAMES change strategy aligned to business, security, safety and regulatory objectives, ensuring integration with wider delivery plans and benefits across the Logistics and Support portfolio.
Establish and maintain change governance and control processes, ensuring all JAMES changes are managed, approved and compliant with policy and standards.
Conduct detailed change impact assessments on JAMES systems, processes, data and users, identifying implications across cost, schedule, performance and service delivery.
Develop and execute stakeholder engagement plans, managing relationships across business, technical teams, suppliers and end users.
Design and deliver communication strategies that clearly articulate system changes, impacts and required behaviours to ensure adoption.
Manage risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and opportunities (RAIDO) associated with JAMES change, ensuring timely mitigation and escalation.

Person specification

To be successful with your application, you'll need to show that you meet the following essential criteria
:

Evidence of understanding of how systems, data and technology changes impact business operations and delivery.
Ability to influence, negotiate and maintain effective relationships across diverse audiences.
Strong understanding of governance frameworks, compliance and structured change processes.
Evidence of identifying, assessing and managing risks and dependencies in complex environments.
Experience of managing the relationships between programmes, schedules and technical components.
Evidence of interpreting management information, assessing change effectiveness, challenging assumptions and embedding lessons learned into future delivery.

In addition to the responsibilities above, the following technical competences and behaviours
will be assessed at interview:

: Making Effective Decisions – CSBC3
Core Behaviour 2
: Changing and Improving – CSBC3
Technical Competence 1
: Stakeholder Management – Supervised Practitioner
Technical Competence 2

Our Opportunity

Chewy’s mission is to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents and partners everywhere. We view pets and pet parents as family and are obsessed with meeting their needs and exceeding expectations through every interaction. Within Chewy, the Payments team improves the customer and care team experience by launching better ways to pay, increasing payment success, strengthening payment reliability, and reducing the cost and operational friction of payments.

To support this mission, Chewy is hiring a Senior Program Manager, Payment Operations and Optimization
in Bellevue, WA, Boston, MA, or Plantation, FL
. This role will report to the Head of Payment Partnerships & Operations and serve as a senior operational owner for complex payment capabilities across Chewy. The role will drive payment performance, operational readiness, partner escalation, incident response, and cross-functional execution across recurring, stored payment, and advanced authorization experiences. This includes Autoship and repeat purchase payment flows, stored credentials, backup payment methods, retries, decline recovery, tokenization, digital wallets, payment method lifecycle management, and scenarios involving multiple authorizations or merchant category code (MCC) configurations.

The ideal candidate is an experienced payments and operations leader who has managed payment outcomes in a scaled ecommerce, fintech, subscription, retail, or omnichannel environment. This person brings strong payments knowledge, senior program leadership, and the ability to connect strategic priorities with hands-on operational execution across complex card-not-present and recurring payment models. They can simplify technical payment topics, identify customer and business impact, and lead cross-functional teams through measurable improvements in payment success, authorization performance, customer retention, and operational reliability. This role is well suited for someone who can partner effectively across Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Legal/Compliance, and external payment partners to improve customer experiences.

What You'll Do

Own the operational health, performance, and optimization roadmap for advanced authorization capabilities, stored payment, and recurring, including multi-authorization flows, multiple MCC configurations, and payment method lifecycle workflows.
Define, monitor, and improve key payment metrics, including payment success rate, authorization performance, retry recovery, decline trends, multi-authorization outcomes, MCC configuration impacts, incident volume, and operational SLA performance.
Serve as the senior payment operations owner for launches, enhancements, defects, partner escalations, operational readiness, and post-launch performance management.
Lead cross-functional programs across Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Legal/Compliance, and external payment partners.
Identify payment defects, reliability risks, and customer friction across complex authorization, stored credential, and recurring flows; quantify customer, operational, and financial impact; and drive prioritized resolution.
Partner with payment processors, wallet providers, tokenization providers, and other third parties to manage operational performance, roadmap dependencies, issue resolution, SLAs, and improvement plans.
Analyze issuer, network, processor, card type, wallet, MCC, tokenization, debit routing, retry, and decline-code trends to identify optimization opportunities.
Build executive-ready narratives, business reviews, and recommendations that connect payment performance, customer experience, retention, cost, risk, and business impact.
Serve as a payments subject matter expert for card-not-present, stored credential, recurring billing, multi-authorization, tokenization, digital wallet, debit routing, MCC, refund, reconciliation, and operational support workflows.

What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, operations, technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of experience in payments, fintech, ecommerce, retail, subscription billing, omnichannel operations, or another scaled operational environment.
5+ years leading complex cross-functional programs with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Customer Care/Operations, Legal/Compliance, and external partners.
Experience supporting complex order and payment scenarios where a single order or customer transaction may require multiple authorizations, MCC configurations, settlement paths, or downstream reconciliation.
Demonstrated experience owning payment KPIs and operational outcomes such as payment success rate, authorization rate, decline rate, retry recovery, backup payment method performance, involuntary churn, dispute rate, reconciliation quality, cost of payments, or operational SLA performance.
Direct experience with card-not-present and recurring payment flows, including processors, acquirers, issuers, card networks, digital wallets, stored credentials, tokenization, account updater, settlement, refunds, disputes, and reconciliation.
Experience supporting ecommerce, subscription, and repeat purchase payment environments where reliability directly affects customer retention and business performance.
Strong analytical capability with the ability to use payment data, processor reporting, decline trends, authorization performance, customer feedback, and operational defects to identify root causes and drive action.
Proven ability to operate in ambiguity, dive deep into details, and lead teams through issue resolution without direct authority.
Strong vendor and partner management experience, including performance reviews, escalations, SLA management, roadmap alignment, and operational improvement plans.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level narratives, business reviews, and decision recommendations.
Ability to deliver time-sensitive initiatives while maintaining strong attention to detail and ownership of follow-through.
Ability to travel up to 15% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with payment models that include multi-authorization flows, multiple MCC configurations, settlement, and reconciliation.
Experience improving authorization performance through issuer, network, processor, card type, tokenization, digital wallet, debit routing, MCC, or decline-code analysis.
Experience launching or scaling payment capabilities that support high-volume stored payment methods.
Experience improving payment observability, operational support models, and partner performance in a high-volume environment.
Experience with card-not-present payment operations, including ecommerce, fintech, subscription, or other complex digital payment workflows.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Recurring, stored payment, and advanced authorization workflows are reliable, measurable, and supported by clear operational mechanisms.
Payment success, authorization performance, and customer retention opportunities are identified quickly, quantified clearly, and improved through strong cross-functional ownership.
Payment partner performance is actively managed through business reviews, escalations, SLAs, and improvement plans.
Senior leaders have a clear view of payment performance, authorization risks, tradeoffs, and investment needs.

Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.

Qui sommes-nous?

XNRGY Climate Systems est un chef de file nord-américain dans la conception durable et la fabrication de pointe de systèmes de traitement d'air sur mesure. Axés sur la recherche et le développement énergétique, nous contribuons à la réduction de l'empreinte carbone dans de nombreux secteurs d'activité.

Nous sommes fiers d'annoncer l'ouverture de notre nouveau siège social technologique à Mesa, en Arizona. Cette expansion témoigne de notre engagement envers la croissance, l'innovation et le développement de solutions climatiques durables.

L'opportunité

Aperçu du poste

Le ou la gestionnaire du programme de produits est un leader clé de l’exécution responsable de coordonner l’ensemble du cycle de vie de systèmes thermiques sur mesure à haut rendement, depuis le lancement de la commande jusqu’à la préparation à l’expédition. Agissant comme lien essentiel entre la conception et la livraison physique du produit, cette personne assure l’exécution interfonctionnelle entre les équipes d’Ingénierie, de Fabrication, de Chaîne d’approvisionnement, de Logistique et de Qualité.

La personne idéale ne se contente pas d’assurer le suivi des tâches; elle prend en charge les risques liés aux programmes, favorise la préparation opérationnelle, remet en question les écarts d’exécution et garantit que les engagements pris envers les clients sont livrés à temps, dans le respect du budget et selon les plus hauts standards de qualité.

Principales responsabilités – Incluant, sans s’y limiter

Définir et diriger la stratégie d’exécution de bout en bout pour plusieurs projets complexes et à forte valeur ajoutée, de l’étude de faisabilité initiale jusqu’à la préparation à l’expédition, tout en protégeant les échéanciers, la qualité et les marges.
Valider la faisabilité de l’exécution avant l’engagement interne des programmes, notamment en ce qui concerne le réalisme des échéanciers, la maturité de l’ingénierie et les contraintes de fabrication.
Remettre en question l’état de préparation de l’ingénierie et exercer l’autorité nécessaire pour interrompre la progression lorsqu’une conception n’a pas atteint le niveau de maturité requis pour la production.

new_jobs.title: ASIC Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Etched

Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference
. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

Job Summary

Etched is seeking a highly skilled and motivated ASIC Technical Program Manager to join our silicon team. This is a hands-on, high-accountability role for someone who has lived inside the ASIC development cycle and can drive technical execution, not just track it. You will own program coordination across Physical Design, DFT, DV, and RTL teams while managing relationships with external vendors including IP providers, implementation partners, and EDA tool vendors. The ideal candidate has real tape-out experience, understands the full RTL-to-GDSII flow, and operates with the urgency and proactivity that a first-silicon program demands.

Key Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Technical Coordination: Own program management across Physical Design, DFT, DV, RTL, and Post-Silicon teams. Understand inter-team dependencies - know who owns what, when handoffs need to happen, and what needs to be signed off before downstream work can begin (e.g., RTL version gates for synthesis, DFT insertion checkpoints, ECO cycles).
Vendor Management: Engage directly with external vendors, including EDA partners and implementation partners. Hold vendors accountable to timelines and deliverables. Be prepared to push back, defend Etched’s technical requirements, and escalate when needed.
Risk Identification and Mitigation: Proactively surface critical path risks, schedule slippage, and cross-team blockers. Develop mitigation strategies in partnership with engineering leads and escalate appropriately to technical and executive stakeholders.
Project Planning and Execution: Manage the scheduling and execution of complex, multi-team hardware programs. Keep projects on track across tape-out milestones, synthesis respins, and signoff cycles.
Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular, clear updates to engineering leads, VP-level stakeholders, and executive leadership on project status, risks, and decisions required. Set the tone for meetings, facilitate alignment, mediate technical disagreements, and drive to decisions.
Process Coordination: Work with ops and engineering teams to maintain accurate tracking of program state, action owners, and open items. Support the adoption of tooling and dashboards that improve engineering visibility - though dashboard creation itself sits with the ops team.
Technical Acumen: Bring enough ASIC domain knowledge to communicate credibly with engineers across the design stack and with external partners. You don’t need to be a designer, but you need to know the difference between a .3 and .5 RTL release, understand where DFT fits in the flow, and have a feel for what a synthesis restart actually involves.

You may be a good fit if you have (Must-have qualifications)

At least one full ASIC tape-out under your belt. You should be able to speak fluently to what that process looks like end-to-end.
Solid understanding of the RTL-to-GDSII flow, including where Physical Design, DFT, DV, and RTL teams intersect and hand off to each other.
5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related role within the semiconductor or hardware space.
Experience working directly with external EDA vendors or implementation partners - you’ve been in those rooms and know how to hold your ground.
Exceptional follow-through and proactivity. You chase down dependencies; you don’t wait for them to surface.
Strong communication and facilitation skills - you set a productive tone in meetings, keep discussions on track, and bring people to alignment.
Comfort with fast-paced, ambiguous startup environments where priorities shift and programs evolve quickly.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage
$500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits

Housing subsidy of $2k per month for those living within walking distance of the office
Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)
Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more
Daily lunch and dinner in our office
Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification

How We’re Different

Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference-focused frontier AI system. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.

We are a fully in-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

to help shape and operate our information security and digital operational resilience framework. Reporting directly to the CISO
, you will take a key role in implementing and maturing our Cyber Defence capabilities
in close collaboration with IT, Risk, Internal Audit and Management. As Cyber Security Manager, you will own our defensive security technology stack and our incident-readiness capability.

Practical experience deploying and operating EDR/XDR platforms (e.g. CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender) and other core defensive tooling.

new_jobs.title: Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
What The Role Is

ISD confronts and addresses threats to Singapore’s internal security and stability. For over 75 years, ISD and its predecessor organisations have played a central role in countering threats such as those posed by foreign subversive elements, spies, racial and religious extremists, and terrorists. A fulfilling and rewarding career awaits those who want to join in ISD’s critical mission of keeping Singapore safe, secure and sovereign for all Singaporeans.

What You Will Be Working On

The Intelligence Analyst has to process information gathered through a variety of sources (e.g. open source reporting, investigations, etc.), synthesising and crystallising these into timely, useful and actionable intelligence. A core part of an Intelligence Analyst’s work is sense-making. You will have to make sense and paint a coherent picture of developments which are at times complex and conflicting, identify information gaps, assess security implications and anticipate developing threats. As an Intelligence Analyst, you will undertake different aspects of analysis, such as operational analysis, strategic analysis and policy analysis. In operational analysis, you will provide support for investigations to neutralise security threats. You will also be involved in strategic analysis, which entails broader and longer-term monitoring of trends to identify threats and make sound security assessments. In policy analysis, you will examine policies that have an impact on internal security, to provide an accurate assessment of implications and make recommendations on how best to safeguard Singapore’s security interests. Given the complex and rapidly-evolving security terrain, your work will be fast-paced, challenging and stimulating.

What We Are Looking For

Degree in any discipline or equivalent competencies
Strong analytical ability – able to process large volumes of information to surface pertinent security points/trends, develop insights into security threats on the horizon, and distil the implications for Singapore’s internal security
Meticulous with an eye for detail
Keen interest in current affairs and security issues
Strong writing skills – competent in drafting clear and succinct reports
Able to work independently, as well as in a team
Useful to have good communication and presentation skills
Only Singaporeans need apply

We wish to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

new_jobs.title: Cleared Senior/Principal R&D Technical Targeting Intelligence Analyst, Onsite
new_jobs.description:
About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwide
Extraordinary co-workers
Some of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the world
Career advancement and enrichment opportunities
Flexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)
Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

These benefits vary by job classification.

What Your Job Will Be Like

We are seeking an experienced intelligence analyst to play a critical role in countering emerging national security threats by partnering with subject matter experts to conduct in-depth technical analysis of intelligence data from multiple sources. Your work will focus on evaluating hard and advanced technologies and associated capabilities, such as specialized infrastructure and research pipelines, to provide actionable insights that support U.S. intelligence community and Department of War objectives.

This position supports both technical and policy customers within the intelligence community. To ensure your success, we provide formal and informal training during onboarding and throughout your growth in the role.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong aptitude for learning, a proactive ¿can-do¿ attitude, comfort working in ambiguity and applying engineering judgement, proactive, and effective collaboration skills. You will work on a dynamic cadence that includes urgent same-day requests as well as longer-term projects spanning several months.

On any given day, you may be called on to:

All-Source Technical Analysis

Conduct comprehensive all-source intelligence analysis on technical topics, synthesizing information from various sources including SIGINT, HUMINT, OSINT, MASINT, and GEOINT into clear analytic messages.
Work comfortably with limited and evolving information to make engineering judgements across various levels of rigor and effectively communicate uncertainties.
Work comfortably outside your field of expertise while still providing grounded technical insights either by self-learning or through building and collaborating with a network of experts across Sandia National Laboratories.
Understand U.S. IC tradecraft standards and how to tailor information to your final products.
Understand and tailor your work to the needs of intelligence end-users in scope, focus, and delivery method.

Analytic Review

Conduct analytic reviews outside your area of technical expertise to evaluate the quality and relevance of findings, ensuring analyses are robust, accurate, appropriately caveated, and aligned with customer needs.
Use critical thinking and analytic techniques to assess source validity and information reliability.

Communication

Produce clear, concise, and well-structured findings across a variety of report templates tailored to high-level customers.
Ensure written products meet established standards and deadlines.
Prepare and deliver briefings to internal and external partners, communicating complex technical information clearly.

Collaboration

Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, fostering teamwork and shared objectives, including federal sponsors, intelligence community partners, technical experts, scientists, and technologists.

Leadership

Foster a positive and collaborative team environment by proactively seeking opportunities to shape future initiatives and partnerships, while contributing to continuous improvement of yourself and others.

Due to the nature of the work, the selected applicant must be able to work onsite 100% of the time.

Qualified candidates may be asked to provide a writing sample (500 words or more) prior to any scheduled interviews.

Applicants on this requisition may be interviewed by multiple organizations at Sandia National Laboratories.

Salary Range

$117,500 - $235,700

Salary range is estimated, and actual salary will be determined after consideration of the selected candidate's experience and qualifications, and application of any approved geographic salary differential.

Qualifications We Require

A Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and five (5) years of directly relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of directly relevant education and engineering or scientific experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and ability to perform independent research and development.
Active SCI clearance required to start.
Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE Q security clearance.

Qualifications We Desire

The ideal R&D Systems Research and Analysis candidate for Sandia National Laboratories will in addition possess the following:

Graduate degree in a highly related field where an independent research project was a graduation requirement (e.g., independent project, thesis, or dissertation).
The ability to understand, synthesize, and draw insights from multiple types of data streams (e.g., technical, economic, policy) through the use of various analytical tools.
Experience working as part of multi-disciplinary teams examining complex systems.
Knowledge of the fundamentals of good project management, especially as it pertains to the execution of federally-funded work (e.g., proposal development through annal review, final delivery, and closeout).
Experience working with federal sponsors in the defense and intelligence sectors, as well as their domestic FFRDC partners, international partnering agencies, and foreign governments.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams delivering critical information to customers in a succinct manner.

Also, for this posting we are seeking individuals with the following experience:

Experience working in the intelligence community, especially in a role requiring the analysis of disparate streams of data to provide insights into emerging threats and evaluate risks and opportunities.
Demonstrated understanding of the intelligence cycle, including planning, collection, processing, analysis, and dissemination.
Experience briefing senior officials and stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to produce clear, well-organized technical documentation and communicate findings succinctly.
Proven track record of proactively managing responsibilities, taking ownership, and delivering results reliably.
Demonstrated ability to apply sound technical judgements outside of area of expertise through cultivation of relationships with other subject matter experts and self-learning.
Demonstrated leadership potential with emphasis on teamwork, initiative, and workplace improvement.
Adaptability to changing priorities.

About Our Team

The primary mission of the Threat Assessments Group (5920) is to assess the threats posed to US national security interests by foreign advanced weapons and technological capabilities, with emphasis on nuclear weapons. Our analyses inform policymakers and senior officials across the US government responsible for understanding the threats and risks posed by these weapons and relevant technologies. This high impact program area is steadily growing and stewards key capabilities associated with all-source intelligence analysis, computational modeling, and engineering studies.

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

Security Clearance

Position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) SCI security clearance to start, or equivalent active security clearance with another U.S. government agency (e.g., DOD). Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance and SCI access, both of which require US citizenship. SCI access may also require a polygraph examination. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain these levels of access may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by the DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

Eeo

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements For MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

👩 💻 The role

We're looking for a sharp, hungry analyst to join the data team at Headout. This is a foundational role, you'll work closely with senior analysts and leadership to build the reports, dashboards, and automations that power decisions across the company.

Depending on where the need is greatest and where your strengths lie, you could find yourself working on growth and marketing analytics, product analytics, operations and supply-side problems, or a mix of all three. The common thread: you'll be embedded in the business, working on problems that matter.

This isn't about crunching numbers in a corner. You'll understand how our marketplace works, why metrics move, and what levers actually drive outcomes. You'll ship real work within your first week, and own meaningful workstreams within your first few months.

If you're someone who gets restless when you're not learning, who'd rather figure things out than wait for instructions, and who cares about craft, this is for you.

🤩 What makes this role special?

Real problems, not busywork
: Headout is a global marketplace operating across dozens of cities, thousands of experiences, multiple currencies, real-time inventory, and dynamic pricing. Whether you're analyzing conversion funnels, attribution models, supplier economics, or product experiments, the problems here are genuinely hard.
Breadth of exposure
: You won't be siloed into one corner of the business. You'll see how growth, product, operations, and finance interconnect and build the analytical muscle to work across all of them.
Learn fast by doing
: You'll pair with senior analysts on complex projects, get direct feedback from leadership, and see your work influence actual decisions. The feedback loops are tight, and the growth curve is steep.
A team that gives a damn
: We care about speed and pragmatism over perfection, but we don't ship sloppy work. Feedback is direct and frequent. We document what we learn. We help each other get better.
A product you can care about
: Headout helps people experience the best of every city they visit. There's something satisfying about working on a product where the output is someone having a great day somewhere new.

💝 What skills & experience do you need?

1 - 3 years in an analytics, BI, or data science role
Strong SQL skills, you can write complex joins, window functions, CTEs without hand-holding. You know how to debug a slow query.
Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation, automation, or simple analysis
Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Nice to have: exposure to dbt, Airflow, or similar; basic understanding of data warehousing concepts
Bonus: exposure to marketplace/e-commerce, consumer tech

As a Senior TPM, you will bridge the gap between architectural concepts and physical silicon. Your mission is to accelerate tape-out cycles by optimizing engineering workflow schedules and to track Closed-Loop Validation

Drive the "Arch-to-Silicon" lifecycle, developing high-fidelity schedules and handling complex dependencies across design, verification, physical implementation and tape-out validation
Act as the primary strategic liaison between CSG and cross-functional partners, including VLSI, Architecture, ASIC, Operations and Systems
Participate in key design reviews and handle the change control process to ensure scope changes are balanced against schedule impacts.
Lead Closed-Loop Validation schedules by systematically comparing silicon results against simulation assumptions to refine future model accuracy.
Orchestrate post-silicon test plans, ensuring comprehensive coverage of architectural requirements, PVT corners, and critical corner cases
Build expert-level Smartsheet dashboards to provide real-time insight into program health, test plan progress, and prioritization for executive team.
Drive operational excellence by codifying procedures and employing Python to automate the ingestion of lab data into project management tools.

What We Need To See

BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience (Masters preferred)
8+ years of TPM experience with a focus on Semiconductor Design and the full ASIC/SoC lifecycle.
Strong technical fluency in VLSI, specifically regarding design cycle, silicon validation and correlation
Ability to align different teams on a unified execution path and influence technical trade-offs.
Demonstrate critical thinking with the ability to synthesize complex technical data into actionable project plans.
Outstanding negotiation and presentation skills; ability to influence senior engineering staff without direct authority.
Expert-level Smartsheet proficiency is required, including advanced automation and visual dashboarding.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Direct background in circuit design or hardware validation.
Proficiency in Python to automate data-driven project management tasks.
Experience running projects in cutting-edge process nodes.
